items.question: What fine range does the UAE Federal Law No. 10 of 2015 on Food Safety set for misleading consumers through a false food description or incorrect labels?
items.gold: A fine ranging from AED 10,000 to 100,000.
items.fact: Misleading food labels or descriptions fined AED 10,000 to 100,000.

items.question: Under the National Food Accreditation and Registration System, must food be registered in the electronic system ZAD before it is handled in UAE markets?
items.gold: Yes, food must be registered in ZAD before being handled in the UAE's markets.
items.fact: Food must be registered in ZAD before UAE market handling.
